children: AU Small Finance Bank (AU SFB) announced on Monday the appointment of Anil Agarwal as Senior Executive Group Head, Commercial & Institutional Banking and Amol Padhye as Chief Risk Officer, as the lender prepares for its proposed transition to a Universal Bank following an RBI in-principle approval.

Anil Agarwal brings close to three decades of banking experience, including over twenty years at Axis Bank where he held senior roles across transaction banking, government business, financial institutions and corporate banking. A rank-holder Chartered Accountant and Cost & Management Accountant, he will oversee AU SFB’s commercial and institutional platform spanning wholesale liabilities, cash management, capital markets and sustainability initiatives.

Amol Padhye, a Chartered Accountant with 23 years in risk management, joins from HDFC Bank and EY, where he led risk transformation and regulatory governance mandates. As CRO, he will head enterprise-wide risk governance, credit and market risk, model risk and regulatory readiness, areas that become increasingly critical as the bank scales toward universal bank status.
Founder, MD and CEO Sanjay Agarwal said the appointments reinforce the bank’s focus on disciplined growth and long-term value creation.

The hirings come as AU SFB, India’s largest small finance bank, reported a deposit base of ₹1,57,727 crore and a total loan portfolio of ₹1,44,250 crore as of June 30, 2026, on a balance sheet exceeding ₹1.9 lakh crore.

The bank’s stock, however, reflected broader market caution on Tuesday, trading at ₹1,037.50 on the NSE, down 2.02 per cent from Friday’s close of ₹1,058.90, giving AU SFB a market capitalisation of approximately ₹77,872 crore. The scrip has nonetheless gained over 45 per cent in the past year, significantly outperforming the Nifty Bank index’s 2.32 per cent return over the same period.

title: AU Small Finance Bank bolsters top deck with two senior hires
